channel.title: ACE audit reports
channel.description: New and updated audit reports from Audit Clinical Evidence.

item.title: Audit of Singh et al. (1997)
item.dc:creator: Matthew B. Jané
Kutenda F. Mvududu
item.description: 1997 RCT of resistance training for depression in older adults: SEs labeled as SDs, so 19 of 24 meta-analyses carry it at up to 11 times its true effect. 110 integrity violations; retraction recommended.

item.title: Audit of Abdelbasset et al. (2019)
item.dc:creator: Matthew B. Jané
Kutenda F. Mvududu
item.description: Three 2019 RCTs on exercise for depression in heart failure: overlapping trial arms, duplicated PHQ-9 data, impossible statistics and baseline p-values. 29 integrity violations; retraction recommended.
